notes.title: Bioguard is on Made in Brazil Sale
notes.notes:
🌟 We're thrilled to announce that Bioguard is taking part in the "Made in Brazil" event on Steam! 🇧🇷 From February 14 to 19, immerse yourself in this unique experience and discover a world full of challenges and fun!

🎉 We invite you to embark on this journey with us as we defend the human body from evil invaders! 💪💉 Explore a scenario inside the human body, while putting together strategies to avoid contamination by viruses and bacteria.

🌈 But that's not all! 🌟 At "Made in Brazil", we're proud to be part of an incredible community of Brazilian developers. 🇧🇷🎮 Take this opportunity to discover and support other talents from our country by trying out their games and immersing yourself in their unique stories!

💥 So, what are you waiting for? Join in the fun, try Bioguard and immerse yourself in the world of Brazilian games on Steam! 🚀💫
 Don't forget to share your love of games made in Brazil! 🌟🎮 

Here's the link to the event: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42974040/sale/MadeinBrazilSale

notes.title: Bioguard Live!
notes.notes:
Playing Bioguard live!

Bioguard is a tower defense roguelite with a biological theme. Help the immune system using a variety of towers, skills and special cards. Develop your strategy to protect your body from invading pathogens and prevent their passage to vital organs!
